// diagnostic

E0377

`#Known` is retired.

What

`#Known` is retired.

Why

Compile time has one mark, `@`, and the mark belongs to the name, so it is written at every mention.

Fix

Write `@name :: …` for a binding, `@if <condition> { … }` for a compile-time branch, and `@ { … }` for a compile-time block.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0377: tests/ui/comptime_known_block_retired.stderr.

    |
  3 |     #Known {
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: compile time has one mark, `@`, and the mark belongs to the name, so it is written at every mention
 Fix: write `@ { … }`
